floorjack.title: Raise and lower the jack
floorjack.caption: Raise the saddle on the low red trolley jack. Press down lightly on the saddle and check that it stays raised and level. Lower it to its starting height and leave the jack’s base in place. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

door.title: Cycle the car door and window
door.caption: Unlatch the aisle-side front door of the hatchback car on the two-post lift. Swing the door open and lower its window. With the window down, swing the door partly shut and open it again. Raise the window, close the door fully and seat the latch. Leave nearby equipment in place. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

wheel.title: Remove and refit the wheel
wheel.caption: Use the red two-post lift to raise the hatchback car and check that it holds level. Remove the five lug nuts from the front wheel nearest the aisle. Pull the wheel clear of the hub, carry it away, lay it flat on the floor and let go. Lift it again, turn it upright, align it on the same hub and refasten all five lug nuts. Lower the car until all four lift pads support it. Leave nearby equipment in place. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

drawer.title: Stow the 17 socket
drawer.caption: Open the top drawer of the freestanding red rolling toolbox beside the workbench with the three sockets. Put the middle socket, marked 17, into the drawer, then add the torque wrench from the same workbench. Close the drawer and reopen it to check that both tools stayed inside. Close it again and leave the surrounding tools in place. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

funnel.title: Move the oil-drain caddy
funnel.caption: Roll the red oil-drain caddy (Oildrain) from its storage spot beside the lift into the clear aisle behind the hatchback car. Let it stop upright, then raise its funnel. Give the funnel a light touch and check that it holds its height and stays level. Lower the funnel, roll the caddy back to its original spot and leave it upright and still, with nearby equipment in place. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

washer.title: Wash the bolt
washer.caption: Take the leftmost bolt from the blue parts tray on the freestanding red toolbox. Set it on the slatted insert inside the open red parts washer (Partswasher) on the workbench. Close the lid and leave the bolt covered for a moment. Reopen the lid, check that the bolt stayed in the basin and return it to its original spot in the blue tray. Close the washer and leave nearby objects in place. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

masking.title: Move the masking cloth
masking.caption: Recorded cloth simulation. On the workbench with the row of sockets, lift the front edge of the large tan masking cloth clear of the bench lip. Pull the hanging edge back onto the work surface, then let go and let the cloth settle on the bench.

rag.title: Lift the blue cloth
rag.caption: Recorded cloth simulation. Find the small blue cloth beside the large tan masking cloth on the workbench with the row of sockets. Lift the blue cloth’s front edge, pull it farther onto the work surface and let go. Leave it resting on the bench.
